description: Semantic genome for basicbrowserslim SPA runtime. Contains the minimal set of behavioral invariants required to regenerate observable behavior under valid transformations. Each gene is evidence-backed and invalidatable. Transform laws are only valid when the genes they cite remain verified.

genes.subject: surfaceManager.buildSurface
genes.statement: buildSurface(si, ii, phase) always resolves to surface|null, never rejects. Failures are caught internally and normalize to null. Callers never need try/catch.
genes.observable_effect: Rasterization failures degrade gracefully to a no-animation fallback; they never crash a transition.
invalidated_by: any change that causes rasterizeHero to reject without internal catch
removal of the try/catch in buildSurface

genes.subject: appKernel._rasterizeProbeSurface
genes.statement: _rasterizeProbeSurface always resolves to surface|null, never rejects. Probe cleanup always runs in finally regardless of success or failure.
genes.observable_effect: Probe DOM elements never leak. _buildSurfacePair's Promise.all never rejects from either input.
invalidated_by: removal of the try/catch/finally in _rasterizeProbeSurface
any path where probe.cleanup is called conditionally rather than in finally

genes.subject: appKernel._renderTarget
genes.statement: _renderTarget(si, ii) is the authoritative full visible-state render. It calls renderHeroDOM + updateSectionNav + updateItemDots atomically. It is the only valid way to commit a new (si, ii) position to the DOM.
genes.observable_effect: Hero DOM, section nav, and item dots are always in sync after any position commit.
invalidated_by: any direct call to renderHeroDOM outside _renderTarget that does not also call updateSectionNav + updateItemDots
addition of new nav/hero sync side-effects to any of the three renderers

genes.subject: appKernel._withTransition + transitionKernel.runTransition
genes.statement: All transitions follow the phase grammar: capture(surfaces) → animate(particles) → reveal(handoff) → commit/cleanup. _withTransition enforces idle→transitioning→idle bracketing around every run, including on failure.
genes.observable_effect: _phase is never left in 'transitioning' after a transition completes or throws. body.dataset.state always reflects the post-transition phase.
invalidated_by: any transition that bypasses _withTransition and sets _phase directly
removal of the finally block in _withTransition
change to reveal handoff ordering in transitionKernel

genes.subject: transitionKernel
genes.statement: transitionKernel owns all transient hero visibility mutations. hideHero/showHero/hideCanvas/showCanvas are the canonical operators. No module outside transitionKernel may set heroEl.style.visibility or heroEl.style.opacity directly.
genes.observable_effect: Hero visibility state is always the result of a canonical operator, never of ad-hoc style mutation.
invalidated_by: any new direct heroEl.style.visibility or heroEl.style.opacity assignment outside transitionKernel
export of heroContainer to a module that is not transitionKernel

genes.subject: appKernel._exitCurrentContextWithTransition
genes.statement: context-exit is a named phenotype: {same-position surface pair, runTransition, onReveal hook, startTracking on finish}. Both closeOverlayWithTransition and exitGameToCurrentItem are instances. _exitCurrentContextWithTransition is the canonical implementation.
genes.observable_effect: Overlay-close and game-exit produce identical observable phase transitions. New context-exit flows should route through the same phenotype.
invalidated_by: addition of a new context-exit flow that does not use _exitCurrentContextWithTransition
divergence in cleanup semantics between overlay-close and game-exit

genes.subject: appKernel.cancelSlingshot
genes.statement: slingshot-cancel is a named postcondition set: {hideCanvas, showHero, _cleanupPull, startTracking(si,ii), notifyView(onActivate)}. All five effects are required. Omitting any is a behavioral regression.
genes.observable_effect: After cancel: hero is visible, canvas is hidden, phase is idle, surface tracking is running, view is notified.
invalidated_by: removal of any of the five effects from cancelSlingshot
change to the tracking or hero visibility ownership model

genes.subject: probe lifecycle
genes.statement: Probes are feature-owned, runtime-consumed. Feature modules own probe creation and cleanup via buildHeroProbe/buildProbe. appKernel consumes probes via _rasterizeProbeSurface but must not hardcode feature identities (e.g., no string literal 'games' in transition paths).
genes.observable_effect: New feature types add a probe builder to the feature module; appKernel transition paths gain zero new conditionals.
invalidated_by: addition of a feature-specific string literal or import in any appKernel transition path
probe cleanup moved out of the feature module into appKernel

genes.subject: appKernel._computeUiState
genes.statement: Visible UI state is a pure function of (_phase, overlay.isOpen()). The state domain is: 'idle' | 'transitioning' | 'pulling' | 'overlay'. _computeUiState is authoritative. body.dataset.{state,section,item} are its derived outputs.
genes.observable_effect: CSS and external code reading body.dataset.state see a value that is always consistent with runtime phase.
invalidated_by: addition of a new phase or state value without updating _computeUiState
any direct write to body.dataset.state outside _syncUiState

genes.subject: navModel
genes.statement: navModel's only public export is getTargetForDirection. getAvailableSections, getNextTarget, and getPrevTarget are module-private. appKernel is the sole consumer of the public API.
genes.observable_effect: Navigation target computation is fully encapsulated; external modules cannot depend on internal helpers.
invalidated_by: addition of any new export from navModel
a second module importing from navModel

genes.subject: surfaceManager.startTracking / stopTracking
genes.statement: stopTracking and startTracking are symmetric lifecycle operators. stopTracking cancels any deferred RAF and clears _trackingKey. startTracking calls stopTracking first, then re-primes the surface cache after one RAF (skipped for GIF/view-probe heroes). Every stopTracking must eventually have a paired startTracking or the cache is permanently stale.
genes.observable_effect: The cached hero surface is always fresh when a transition begins. Transitions never use stale surfaces from a prior position.
invalidated_by: any _withTransition(stopTracking:true) call that does not also set startTracking:true or manually call startTracking
change to the deferred RAF timing in startTracking

genes.subject: retained DOM ↔ immediate-mode canvas handoff
genes.statement: The live hero DOM element and the transition canvas are distinct rendering domains. transitionKernel switches between them via hideHero+showCanvas (enter particle domain) and _revealHandoff (return to DOM domain). They must never be simultaneously visible outside the cross-fade window.
genes.observable_effect: No visual double-rendering. The hero element is hidden exactly during particle animation and revealed only after the canvas fades out.
invalidated_by: any code that shows the hero element while the canvas is also displayed with opacity > 0, outside the cross-fade transition
any new rendering domain added without a corresponding hide/show operator in transitionKernel

transform_laws.name: dead-catch elimination
transform_laws.statement: A try/catch around Promise.all([...inputs]) is removable without trace divergence if every input promise satisfies surf-001 or surf-002.

transform_laws.name: dead-export elimination
transform_laws.statement: An export keyword on a function is removable if zero modules outside the file import that name.

transform_laws.name: ownership consolidation
transform_laws.statement: A direct DOM mutation in module A is movable to module B if B already owns that DOM subtree per the ownership genome, and the mutation is functionally symmetric to an existing operator in B.
transform_laws.witness: Pass 3: cancelSlingshot inline heroEl.style.* replaced with transitionKernel.showHero().

transform_laws.name: phenotype extraction
transform_laws.statement: Two code paths are collapsible into a shared helper if their runtime traces are equivalent under the behavioral genes, differing only in a hook parameter (e.g., onReveal callback).

transform_laws.name: render target canonicalization
transform_laws.statement: Any direct call to heroRenderer.renderHeroDOM(si, ii) outside _renderTarget is replaceable with _renderTarget(si, ii) if the caller also needs nav sync, or removable if nav sync is provably up-to-date at that point.
transform_laws.witness: Pass 2: hardcoded game-enter flow's mount call replaced with _renderTarget(_si, _ii).
